thread:
Alex H.: Hey team — planning a small series of pop-up "Spotlight" stations next month to hand out condensed spot-award kits and quick notes. Want to coordinate volunteers, shipping vs desk-drops, and a lightweight ROI tracking sheet. Ideas? :sparkles:
Priya: Love it. Which offices / dates are we covering? also what's in the kit?
Alex H.: Tentative: SF 4/8-4/9, NY 4/15, London 4/22, Remote care-pack mailout week of 4/29. Kit = 1x thank-you card, 1x enamel pin, 1x small snack, 1x QR card to submit a quick shoutout.
Marcus: I can run SF. How many kits per day?
Alex H.: Aim 200/day for SF, 150 for NY, 120 for London. Remote kits ~ 500 total. Inventory wise: total ~ 1,220 (+10% buffer).
Lina: Do we have budget approval? and tax/treat rules for international shipping? flagged with Legal last quarter.
Samira: Budget approved in the Q ops budget doc. For international, we need customs-declared value under $50 per country to avoid VAT thresholds — ops_bot confirmed earlier. 
ops_bot: Reminder: for physical gifts > $100 to UK recipients please file the gift tax form. See internal policy: https://redwood-internal/people-ops/gift-policy
Jamal: Logistics question — do we let managers RSVP time slots or sign up publicly? I recommend manager-only shifts for HQ so we avoid bottlenecks.
Priya: Managers only for set-up (first hour). After that, open volunteer sign-ups for 2-3hr windows. I'll create the signup sheet.
Alex H.: Perfect. Priya can you include a quick checkbox for "I can do last-mile handoffs to remote folks" (for folks comfortable with packing/mail runs)?
Priya: Yup. Draft sign-up form uploaded: https://forms.gle/spotlight-signup (please test).
Marcus: For SF volunteers, what time windows?
Priya: Putting: 09:00-11:00, 11:30-14:30, 15:00-17:00. I'll add a small notes field for accessibility needs.
Lina: Shipping vendor rec? we used BoxFleet last time — they handled bulk remote drops well. Need quote for 500 packages.
Samira: I'll ping procurement for rates and expedited options. Also, can we add a tiny survey QR that links to a one-question feedback: "Did this make your day? (yes / no)" for ROI tracking?
Alex H.: Yes — one-question survey and a hidden utm param so we can attribute by office. Example link pattern: https://tiny.redwood/spot?off=SF
Jamal: Who's owning inventory sheet? I can take it and add a packing checklist.
Marcus: Please include SKU numbers and bin locations — saved us last time.
Jamal: On it. I'll add columns: SKU, quantity ordered, quantity received, bin, packer initials, ship date.
Priya: Volunteer schedule + packing shifts will be finalized by EOD Friday. Can volunteers request kit pick-up for remote folks?
Alex H.: Yes, add a free-text field for pickup instructions and remote addresses. Procurement asked we include a standardized import label format in the spreadsheet — I'll paste below:
```
EXPORT_LABEL_TEMPLATE:
Name | Street address | City | State/Region | Postal | Country | Phone | OrderID
```
Priya: Noted. I'll add an export script-friendly tab.
Samira: Quick tax note — for spot awards that include cash-equivalent items, people-ops needs a list of recipients and grossed-up amounts (if applicable). We'll collect receipts and flag anything > $150.
Lina: Good catch. We'll add a column for "tax review required" auto-flag if item unit value > 150.
Alex H.: Final asks: volunteers, packers, and a post-event short async write-up for the All Hands highlights. Can we have a comms blurb ready 1 week before each pop-up?
Priya: I'll draft the blurb and share in #general ops and the office channels.
Marcus: SF team — I'll post sign-up link in the SF office channel after Priya finalizes.
Jamal: Inventory sheet link (work-in-progress): https://docs.redwood/inventory/spotlight-kits (edit access for Jamal, Marcus, Priya).
Alex H.: Thanks all — next sync: Wednesday standup for a 5-min check. :raised_hands:
